title: The Morning of 9/11: A Coastie's Account of Tragedy and Heroism
description: Retired Coast Guardsman and New York native, Keiyon McCoy, and his boatcrew were patrolling the Hudson River when terrorists struck the World Trade Center. Twenty-five years later, he recounts the harrowing scene of the attack and how more than one hundred mariners answered the Coast Guard's call for volunteers to aid in the rescue of half a million people trapped on the shores of lower Manhattan. (U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 1st Class Michael Clark)
keywords: Station New York, BOATLIFT, 9/11, Northeast Coast Guard District, 9/11 25th anniversary, Video Production Team
